title: Anne finds the letters link the visitors with the dead

tellings.quote: So she comes out of her office one day. She says, "Whitley, this has something to do with what we call death."

plain: After reading the letters readers sent about the beings they called visitors, Anne Strieber concluded that these beings have something to do with death. Her husband, the author Whitley Strieber, tells Jesse Michels that she came out of her office one day and said, "Whitley, this has something to do with what we call death." The letters came in response to his book Communion, about his own encounters, in the late 1980s. If she was right, the visitors would be bound up with the dead and not simply with other planets.
